reasons: Section 22.1–22.2 meets the preferred position on every material term: once per twelve months, thirty days' prior written notice, normal business hours, off-site where practicable, independent auditor bound by confidentiality, Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds five percent, and an express bar on direct access to Customer systems.
Section 22.3 adds customer-favourable protections; no walk-away features (unlimited/unannounced audits or remote access) are present.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or comment was proposed and the original text is unchanged; deterministic check on audit frequency passes.
